title: Fix setTaskStatus to close done tasks
description: From the 2026-08-15 complete code audit: `setTaskStatus` (src/core/mutate.ts:151) sets `closed_at` only for `wont_do`, so a `review -> done` transition via `task set-status` leaves `closed_at: null`, while the same transition via `task finish` (src/core/mutate.ts:409) always stamps it. Two ways of reaching `done` produce divergent records. Fix: stamp `closed_at` for `done` as well.
acceptance: `setTaskStatus(root, id, "done", ...)` on a review task sets `closed_at` to the mutation timestamp.
`setTaskStatus` to `wont_do` still sets `closed_at`; transitions to other statuses leave it unchanged.
A test asserts `task finish` and `set-status done` produce equivalent `done` records with respect to `closed_at`.
All checks green: `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run check`, `waystation validate`.
notes: Reported as audit finding #1 (medium). Follows ADR-0007 lifecycle matrix: `review -> done` is a valid non-claim transition.
